utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use help sorting donations and loading the bigger items. If you’ve got time, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with both. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the drop-off time and where the repairs are being collected first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I’m not handing anything over without those details either. Can you confirm the drop-off time and collection spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once we’ve got the drop-off time and collection spot confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m around if you want to fill me in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, thanks, Noah. I’m still gathering the details, but I’ll let you know once I’ve got the basics sorted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just give me a shout when you’ve got it figured out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and tell anyone I bump into.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep reminding neighbors and see if anyone can lend a hand or some extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — I’ve got the tools and can help sort the jobs list. Let’s start with the easy fixes and see what needs a bigger hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll start with the easy fixes and help where I can. What job do you want me on first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple: tell me the time, place, and what needs fixing, and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—how about Saturday at 10am at my place on Maple Street? We’re fixing loose porch boards, a leaky faucet, and a stubborn gate latch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 at your place on Maple Street works for me. I’ll bring my basic tools and we can start with the porch boards, then the faucet, then the latch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m still in for today. What time do you want to head over?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you do 2 pm?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—just tell me who needs what, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep a running list of who needs what and where they’re located.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send it over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll help get the right folks linked up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help track volunteers and gather a list of needed supplies? That would really keep us organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can track the volunteers and put together a supplies list. Send me whatever details you have, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little list going for the repair drive—what supplies are we still short on?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let me take a quick look and I’ll tell you what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo—just let me know what we still need, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and a few spare parts already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. If you hear what they’re short on, let me know — I can try to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and let you know what they’re short on. Thanks, Rey, that’d really help the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center parking lot. We’re collecting small appliances, bikes, and household tools, and I can send the exact list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please send the exact list so I can double-check what’s accepted before I help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s a neighborhood drive to collect repair supplies and help folks patch up broken things around here.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the details to neighbors, and let me know if the time or place changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just tools and a steady hand, if you’ve got a bit of time. I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with that. Just point me to where you need me, and I’ll grab whatever tools I can find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you want, I can help sort supplies or spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Rey — thanks. I can bring over my tool kit and help sort whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, Gus — that would help a lot. I’ll make a quick list of supplies and let you know when to come by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Opal — I’m organizing the repair drive list now and will share the next steps soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for the next steps and the location details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — I’ll send the location details and a short sign-up list as soon as I have everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2, and we’re dropping everything off at the community center on Maple. If you want, I can save you a spot and send the details right over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — please save me a spot and send the details over. I just want to make sure I’ve got the timing and address written down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s happening — I’d just double-check the time and place before you pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll confirm the time and place first, then tell people.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — I like having a clear plan. Just let me know the time and what needs doing, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’ll check the time and send you the list of what needs doing soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll keep an eye out for it. Once you send it, I’ll line up my day around the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard folks are still lining things up for the repair drive — is there anything you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’m good for now, but I’ll let you know if we run short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — just send me a note if anything comes up. I’m happy to help from my side of the fence.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to bring something by, but I’m a bit scattered today; what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We could still use screwdrivers, tape, and any spare light bulbs if you’ve got them. No rush—just bring whatever you can when you’re able.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got you—I’ll check my tool drawer and see what I can spare. If I find any screwdrivers, tape, or bulbs, I’ll drop them off soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the repair drive details now so you can coordinate around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, send them over and I’ll work it around pickup.
